card.name: Amara
card.life: Law student who is blind and shops with a screen reader. She hears the page's accessibility tree, never sees it.
constraints: No screenshots, only the accessibility tree
Can only use controls that have a role and a name
card.patience: Expert user. Gives up when a control has no name or an important step is not announced.

goal: Buy three National Park Foundation Explorascopes, one for each of your kids. Before you pay, check the cart: the quantity, the price, shipping and the Total must add up. If they don't, don't pay; leave and say why.

steps.title: Otel Demo - Home

action.why: I found the Explorascope in Hot Products, opening its page to buy three.

steps.result: the page changed to "Otel Demo - Product"

action.why: I see quantity selector, choosing 3 for my three kids.

steps.title: Otel Demo - Product

action.why: Quantity shows 3 selected, price 101.96 each. Adding to cart now.

steps.result: the page changed to "Otel Demo - Cart"

action.reason: Cart shows quantity 3 at $101.96 each but total $128.93 only covers one item plus shipping.
action.why: I see quantity 3 but total matches one item, so I will not pay.

outcome.reason: Cart shows quantity 3 at $101.96 each but total $128.93 only covers one item plus shipping.

findings.summary: click on the page took 344 ms to paint (input delay 31, handlers 21, paint 292).
Console error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

sentence: Amara left at step 4 while checking her cart for three telescopes because she saw quantity 3 at $101.96 each but a total of $128.93, and this wrong price shows only on the screen.
